mapper.select: SELECT event_id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, command_id, event_type, payload, created_at, claim_epoch, retry_base_epoch FROM source_outbox WHERE (status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status='CLAIMED' AND lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, event_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT c.business_effect_key, c.action, c.previous_command_id, c.source_execution_id, c.safe_close_id, c.attempt_no, e.source_service, e.fact_parent_id, e.fact_part_id, e.fact_line_id, e.active_command_id, x.actor_id FROM source_command c JOIN source_effect e ON e.id=c.business_effect_key AND e.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND e.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id JOIN source_execution x ON x.id=c.source_execution_id AND x.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND x.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id AND x.command_id=c.command_id WHERE c.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND c.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND c.command_id=#{commandId}
mapper.update: UPDATE source_outbox SET status=#{status}, error_code=#{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, published_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='PUBLISHED' THEN #{now} ELSE published_at END, lease_until=NULL, next_attempt_at=#{next}, updated_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND status='CLAIMED'
